Lat/Long: 39.081436, -119.942325 (Approximated from route)
Report DescriptionCALLER IS REPORTING A RELEASE OF DIESEL FUEL AND SAND FROM A SEMI TRUCK. CALLER STATED THE DRIVER OF THE SEMI TRUCK WAS HEADING WESTBOUND ON HWY 50, WHEN A LEXUS VEHICLE CAUSED THE DRIVER TO REAR-END ANOTHER SEMI TRUCK. THE WESTBOUND LANE WAS PARTIALLY CLOSED, BUT TRAFFIC IS BEING DIVERTED AROUND THE ACCIDENT.
